title: [Sutana's Designs, Containers]
description: Heavy shelving lines the walls, stacked with cases, baskets, and chests of varying size and material.  Hinged lids rest open on several displays, revealing smooth interiors and careful joinery.  Along a central worktable, smaller boxes are arranged in tidy rows beside labeled placards, while warm lantern light flickers across worn wood and woven fibers.
